name: Connect an account
description: Starts connecting the caller's account at an OAuth provider (google, microsoft, github, or any provider the operator configured). Returns the URL the user must open and approve. Approval alone connects nothing: the venue then gives the browser a one-time completion code, and oauth:complete with that code, from this same account, stores the grant. With returnTo the browser takes the code to that app; without it the venue's page shows the code for the user to give back. Afterwards, call the provider's API with http:get / http:post and bearerSecret "oauth/<provider>" — the access token never appears in your context.

provider.description: A configured provider name — see v/info/adapters/oauth

scopes.description: Scopes to request; the provider's configured defaults when omitted

returnTo.description: The app the browser returns to after approval, with ?code=<completion code> added: a URL under an operator-allowed prefix (adapters.oauth.returnTo)

url.description: The authorisation URL for the user to open — hand it to the user (a hitl ask is the natural way), never open it yourself

state.description: The one-time request identifier bound to this caller

expiresAt.description: Epoch millis after which the request lapses and must be started again
